findings.description: The real far wall to the left of the mirror shows exactly one door (single leaf, one window) with one EXIT sign and a thermostat beside it, and blank wall with an outlet further left. The mirror, which should show that same wall continuing in mirrored order from the corner, instead shows two separate door leaves with windows and two EXIT signs (e.g. frame 37: reflected signs at ~x=380 and ~x=520, door leaves ~305-430 and ~465-560, real sign at ~x=210 only). Projecting the real wall through the mirror using the scene's vanishing points places the real door's reflection at ~x=300-440 and its EXIT sign at ~x=382 (matching the first reflected door), so the second reflected door, EXIT sign, white box and panel correspond to a region of real wall (~x=0-130) that is plain wall. The mirrored room therefore contains a doorway that does not exist in the real room; constant for the whole clip.
